Through a secure, HIPAA-compliant platform, our service connects users with a carefully curated team of wellness professionals. By conducting online consultations via video chat, written journals, and even texting sessions, we have transformed traditional therapy into an experience that is low-cost, convenient, and completely confidential.

Everyone can benefit from an objective perspective during difficult times, but the current model for supportive services is broken due to insurance gridlock, a clunky referral system, long wait times and unsustainable costs. Our web-based approach offers valuable guidance through accessible and anonymous means. Users log in to secure accounts and speak with licensed professionals on a variety of topics—relationship conflict, job stress, etc.—from anywhere at any time. With our proprietary technology, we have removed every barrier to entry and created an outlet for millions who wouldn’t have sought emotional health services otherwise, reducing stress for an increasingly stressed-out generation. This is the future of mental health. 

The shift in moving counseling services online is inevitable and our product is already in demand: After a successful pilot with Pretty Padded Room, an online therapy website specifically targeted towards millennial women, we are excited to relaunch as In Your Corner, an aspirational brand that provides the very best in counseling, coaching, and calm. In Your Corner improves on our original offering by being more gender-inclusive and convenient. In addition to developing a mobile app to provide one-tap, on-demand support in real time, users also have access not only to licensed mental health counselors, but also coaches in personal and professional development as well as instructors of meditation and breath work.

launches.title: Meru Health: A precision, whole-person mental healthcare company
launches.tagline: The new standard of mental healthcare
launches.body:
Meru Health is a precision, whole-person mental healthcare company. Today we launched **Meru Health Advanced** — a 6 to 12 month integrated psychiatry and therapy program for the patients standard care has failed most completely: treatment-resistant depression and anxiety, severe mental illness, and mental health stacked on chronic physical illness.

Every patient starts with a real diagnosis: comprehensive psychiatric visits, a 30–50 biomarker lab panel, and a coordinated team — psychiatrist, therapist, dietitian, care navigator — on one platform. Plus continuous biometric data via Whoop, HRV biofeedback, and lab-informed lifestyle and supplement protocols.

Across 17 peer-reviewed studies (Stanford, Harvard, UCSF, UC Davis, Washington, Rutgers), 55–67% of our patients achieve a 50%+ reduction in depression symptoms in 2–3 months — vs 19–33% on SSRIs. Accorded actuarial analysis: 55% fewer inpatient admissions, 31% fewer ER visits, 23% lower Rx costs.

## **Demo video**

<https://youtu.be/KFnCtezutDo>

## **What's the backstory?**

Kristian and his co-founders Riku and Albert founded Meru after Kristian had lost his brother Peter to suicide. Standard psychiatry couldn't help him; the antidepressants he was prescribed only made him worse. He wasn't an outlier — 30–40% of people with mental health conditions get labeled "treatment-resistant," a phrase I read as a confession that the model itself runs out of options after the second or third prescription.

A decade and 45,000 patients in, our 12-week Therapy program is enough for most. But the most complex patients needed something more: a psychiatrist who understands metabolic and lifestyle medicine, comprehensive labs, a dietitian, and a team that operates as one. That combination didn't exist anywhere. So we built it.

## **What are your asks?**

**1. Patient intros** — anyone who's tried the standard path and not gotten better, especially treatment-resistant and severe conditions, or mental health on a chronic illness. <https://www.meruhealth.com/advanced>

**2. Employer / benefits intros** — Advanced is built for the 6–12% of an employee population driving 30–50% of healthcare spend. Self-insured employers, CHROs, total rewards leads.

**3. Payer intros** — actively expanding insurance coverage. Commercial plans, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid.

**4. Amplification** — likes, shares, and tags on today's LinkedIn + X launch posts.

Ten years in, this is the closest we've come to building the program we wished my brother had had.

— Kristian Riku and Albert

Ophelia helps people quit opioids without going to rehab. We offer online doctor’s visits, withdrawal medication prescriptions, and support for long-term recovery, using a protocol 6x more effective than most rehabs (2/3rds of which don't have doctors).

More than 3 million Americans are addicted to opioids, but 80% are not getting help, due to jobs, families, and privacy concerns. Meanwhile, there's a proven treatment that increases survival rates by 600%, and it's low cost, discreet, and convenient. It's called MAT, and it looks like treatment for anxiety or depression: medication plus therapy. However, doctors need a special waiver to prescribe the medication, which fewer than 5% of them have, so it's difficult to get, and most people are buying it on the street. Sadly, drug dealers aren't doctors: every 11 minutes another American dies of an opioid overdose, now the #1 cause of death for Americans under 50.

Ophelia is replacing rehab with telemedicine, using proven science and a consumer-first approach. The opioid treatment market in the U.S. is $15B, and 85% of opioid addicts have insurance that pays for it. We're treating roughly 400 patients with thousands more waiting.

Zack started Ophelia after losing his girlfriend to an opioid overdose, who found it easier to get medication from a drug dealer than a doctor. We are raising money to help patients in waiting, grow our footprint, save lives, and earn venture-level returns for investors.
one_liner: Medication & support to beat opioid addiction from home

long_description:
Osmind is the premier platform for clinicians and researchers advancing new life-saving mental health treatments. Today, mental health disorders are one of the leading causes of death worldwide, especially among young adults, and are tied to shortening lifespans. While there have been developments in new psychiatric medications since the first FDA approval in 1954, today there is a growing movement among clinicians, patients, and researchers who are recognizing the need to accelerate new science.

The Osmind treatment platform is the first and only solution that solves specific challenges faced by neuropsychiatric clinics, spanning general psychiatry and interventional psychiatry (transcranial magnetic stimulation, ketamine, SPRAVATO®, psychedelic medicine, electroconvulsive therapy). The core electronic health record (EHR) technology is precisely developed for interventional treatment workflows and designed to support a strong therapeutic alliance, including journaling tools and assistance with health plan reimbursement, which is a significant access hurdle for millions of patients.

Research from our platform is already helping to set new standards for mental health interventions. For example, in the largest published real-world analysis of ketamine infusion therapy for depression, we teamed up with Stanford University School of Medicine to share findings in the Journal of Affective Disorders (March 2022). We have multiple ongoing research studies leveraging our proprietary real-world data, including an even larger ketamine analysis leveraging machine learning to predict treatment outcomes.

Osmind is a San Francisco–based public benefit corporation led by scientists, technologists, and psychiatrists. We are backed by top investors including DFJ Growth, General Catalyst, Future Ventures, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator.
one_liner: Platform for breakthrough mental health research and treatment

launches.title: Indy: AI support tool for ADHD
launches.tagline: AI support system that helps with ADHD, not just your to-do list
launches.body:
tl;dr: _After supporting adults with ADHD across 80,000+ coaching sessions, we kept seeing the same gap: people gain clarity about what matters, but struggle to hold onto it in everyday life. Indy is a free, AI-powered ADHD support app designed to help people stay oriented to what matters and translate that clarity into daily action, without relying on productivity pressure or generic AI advice._

_—_

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building Shimmer. Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, their way. Shimmer began after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and struggled to access affordable, high-quality behavioral support. Since then, we’ve grown into the #1 ADHD coaching platform recommended by clinicians across North America.

As large language models became viable, we saw a clear opportunity. ADHD isn’t a problem of knowledge, it’s a problem of continuity. Insight is available, but support disappears between moments. AI, for the first time, makes it possible to provide consistent, personalized scaffolding in the flow of daily life.

That opportunity is what led us to build Indy.

### **❌ The Challenge**

Across tens of thousands of ADHD coaching sessions, one pattern shows up again and again.

Breakthroughs don’t fail because people forget what they learned. They fail because daily life takes over.

People leave a session with clarity about what matters and where they want to go. Then the week happens. Context shifts. Energy fluctuates. Emotions spike. Urgency crowds out direction.

For ADHDers, this breakdown is predictable:

1. **🧠 Executive function is state-dependent**: What feels obvious in one moment is inaccessible in another. Memory, motivation, and prioritization fluctuate with energy and emotion.
2. **🕳 The future fades quickly**: When goals are not emotionally present, the present always wins. ADHD brains respond to what feels salient now.
3. **⏳ Support is episodic and constrained by human capacity**: Coaching, therapy, etc. work primarily during sessions, but disappear when real decisions are being made.

Existing tools don’t address this well. General AI gives answers. Productivity apps manage tasks. Neither maintains orientation or adapts as conditions change.

### **✨ The AI Opportunity**

AI changes what’s possible here.

For the first time, software can:

* Hold personal context over time
* Reflect patterns back to users
* Adapt support based on energy, emotion, and behavior
* Provide lightweight scaffolding between human interactions

This is especially powerful for ADHD, where the problem isn’t knowing what to do, but staying connected to why and when to do it.

### **✨ The Solution**

Indy is a daily AI-powered ADHD support system designed to help people stay oriented to what matters and translate that clarity into everyday action.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=96820&key=user_uploads/608519/4f19593d-f653-4231-9af2-dec8ee54418c)

Here’s how it works:

launches.body:
tl;dr: _After facilitating over 45,000 1:1 ADHD Coaching sessions, we’ve designed Shimmer 2.0, a suite of AI features to support the coaching journey. This isn’t another chatbot or copilot, it’s a suite of embedded AI tools that amplifies the human connection between member & coach—helping members get more out of sessions and between sessions._

—

---

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building [Shimmer](http://www.shimmer.care). Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, _their way_. Shimmer ADHD Coaching was born in 2022 after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and was frustrated with the lack of affordable, quality behavioral coaching solutions. Since then, we’ve grown tremendously, building the #1 ADHD Coaching Platform recommended by HCPs, therapists, and psychiatrists across North America.

<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kHXzu0JYVtg&t=1s>

### **❌ The Challenge**

At Shimmer, we’ve run over 45,000 ADHD coaching sessions. Each session is packed with “aha” moments—but as soon as they’re over, life pulls you in a million directions and those insights slip away. To add to this, the week is often lost from lack of accountability and members come into sessions scrambling to remember the past week. Overall, for people with ADHD, it’s hard to _consistently_ hold onto what you learn, recognize bigger patterns, or stay on track day to day. Why?

1. 🚧 **Our working memory challenges makes it hard to remember sessions**. Even the best breakthroughs vanish without a simple way to capture and revisit them.
2. 👹 **We’re focused on the present & don’t always see the bigger picture (or future)**. Without a clear record, it’s tough to connect recurring themes or measure real progress.
3. 🍬 **We lose momentum between sessions**. A coach can’t be there 24/7—and ADHD brains need constant nudges to stay motivated.

### **✨ The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/53f337be-252d-4135-9f36-9b78d22d1d5b)

**Shimmer 2.0** is our new AI-powered “second brain,” doing what ADHD brains were never designed to do. Shimmer 2.0 automatically captures and organizes all your coaching insights, so you can finally spot the patterns, stay accountable, and turn each breakthrough into real-world action—even when your coach isn’t around. Here’s a bit on how it works:

1. **AI-Powered Session Summaries:** Shimmer 2.0’s AI automatically recaps each session’s main points and action items, so you can easily revisit breakthroughs without piecing together scattered notes.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/57f4600f-1280-4249-842b-1ee892aaa488)

2. **Action Insights & Progress Tracking:** Visually map out your weekly actions, highlight patterns, and keep yourself accountable.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/367d604b-cd7d-465d-ae02-9fef4addd3fa)

3. **History (Second Brain):** View your entire journey in one place & instantly look up specific topics from past sessions and spot recurring themes at a glance.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/ac9d5072-a251-4a37-8c1e-ae4dc05890ae)

4. **Smart Search:** Lastly, my personal favorite—Ask your “second brain” the hard questions, like: “What strategies have worked for me?”, “What did my coach say about procrastination?”, “What should I be proud of”?

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87083&key=user_uploads/608519/af1c2807-67a0-4141-922f-e2dc168185fa)


Check out how Shimmer 2.0 weaves **AI** into your everyday coaching experience, amplifying the power of expert human coaching.

launches.body:
tl;dr: _After facilitating over 31,000 1:1 ADHD Coaching sessions, Shimmer members have access to the first multi-player community feature on the Platform—Body Doubling! Shimmer’s Body Doubling experience takes the popular ADHD co-working strategy and infuses the 6 ADHD motivators to help our members get more things done, the ADHD way._

---

Hi YC family! 👋

We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building [**Shimmer**](http://www.shimmer.care/). Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, _their way_. Shimmer ADHD Coaching was born in 2022 after I (Chris) was diagnosed with ADHD and was frustrated with the lack of affordable, quality behavioral coaching solutions. Since then, we’ve grown tremendously, building the #1 ADHD Coaching Platform recommended by HCPs, therapists, and psychiatrists across North America.

### **❌ The Challenge**

Body doubling is a popular strategy for people with ADHD (it works for neurotypical people too!) to get things done. It’s basically when you work in the presence of others, and the mere existence of them gives you positive accountability to get it done. It comes in many forms, and can even look like you doing laundry while chatting with your boyfriend while he cooks.

The challenge for people with ADHD, is that they don’t do these things consistently. Why?

1. 🚧 **There’s too many hurdles**. They need to coordinate with people, it’s inconsistent, and people are unreliable
2. 👹 **They’re ashamed**. Many body doubling apps exist already, but people with ADHD feel ashamed needing this tool just for their laundry, or to cook, or to do something else that seems mundane. Imagine showing up to a session and you can barely brush your teeth, and the other person says “I’m going to finish emailing back 10 investors on closing my round and launch our new podcast to Spotify”
3. 🍬 **There’s not enough dopamine**. Isn’t this always the challenge with ADHD?! Whatever solution is out there, it’s not built to motivate ADHD brains.

### **✨ The Solution**

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/dd6ff9c4-77bc-4531-9e74-ef8e34bf9129)

Shimmer Body Doubling (only available to Shimmer coaching members) is an ADHD-adapted Body Doubling experience that harnesses the power of the 6 ADHD motivators—interest, urgency, newness, accountability, challenge, and community, to help people with ADHD get things done.

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/8dd2a99e-920e-47bc-adeb-71c8a80adc5a)

3. Get inspired by other people’s tasks and progress. Motivation is contagious!

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/b3e57121-c5dc-46d8-9759-2ec7f5a59743)

4. Visualize time passing (key for ADHD brains!) and beat the clock

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/d5776eb8-0d96-44cc-bc73-d74d8c75ebce)

5. Learn something new in the 5 min break as each ADHD Coach brings their own flare

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/879d8e04-3b90-4cfe-bc46-2c17eed45d0f)

6. If you have a challenge or problem, your community and an expert ADHD coach will be there to help you out!

   ![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83793&key=user_uploads/608519/d4270fef-5134-488c-b32d-e8febd7c71a8)

Hi YC family! 👋 We’re Chris & Vikram, and we’re building [Shimmer](http://www.shimmer.care). Our mission is for every individual with ADHD to reach their full potential, _their way_.

**❌ The Problem**

ADHD is a neurodevelopmental condition that affects 5% of adults (13M in US), but most are still struggling to get their symptoms in check.

* **It’s not a lack of knowledge, it’s action**: People with ADHD know to make a list, they just don’t do it. We need practice, experimentation, and accountability.
* **Good behavioral interventions price most people out:** Quality ADHD coaching costs $300-600+/mo. This prices out, well, the people who need it most.
* **The process is cumbersome & not fit for ADHD**: I’ve been there (Chris): dozens of consultation calls, not knowing what to ask, dated technology, confusing e-mail chains, scared to pull the trigger, the list goes on.

**✨ Our Solution**

Shimmer is a platform that connects expert ADHD coaches with members, facilitates weekly calls, and offers accountability and support via our iOS & Android apps. By truncating or “chunking” the sessions, offering asynchronous tools & resources, and streamlining coaches’ back-end tasks, we offer coaching at 5-10X more affordable than alternatives.

long_description:
Nearly 7 billion hours are spent on porn every year.

Relay provides a modern solution to one of the most widespread yet hidden epidemics of our time: pornography. Despite being one of the biggest drains on focus, relationships, and mental health, it remains one of the most silent and stigmatized problems in society. We are tackling this head-on.

Relay helps people break free through private, anonymous groups that provide accountability and community. Members join a small, confidential team that replaces isolation with connection, offering shame-free accountability, evidence-based tools, and daily reflection.

Our mission goes beyond quitting porn. Relay exists to help people heal the isolation and pain that drive destructive habits—so they can rebuild intimacy, reclaim focus, and live with greater connection, purpose, and wholeness.

launches.title: Relay 💨 Peer support to overcome addiction
launches.tagline: Relay makes it easy to find a tight-knit support system to overcome addiction through deep connection and accountability.
launches.body:
# **Problem**

**Most people struggle alone for years**

And it makes it nearly impossible to see improvement. The person might turn to friends and family, but they overreact or aren’t able to effectively support because they can’t relate. On top of that, professional help or in-person groups can be expensive, and it takes a lot of courage to get there.

**Even those attending in-person groups (e.g. AA) feel isolated between weekly meetings**

For the minority who do join a group-based program, meetings are usually held only once a week — leaving participants largely on their own the other six days of the week.

# **Solution**

Relay helps users…

* Get matched into a team of 5-8 peers
* Experience meaningful connection and avoid slipping back into isolation
* Find shame-free accountability
* Train emotional awareness and understand patterns/triggers
* Throw a red flag (i.e. SOS) with a single tap to let their team know they need help when feeling vulnerable

Since launching in September 2021, 79% of our users have reported seeing improvement within their first month of using the app.

## **Why we’re tackling this**

Members on our team have struggled personally with addiction and saw first-hand the power that comes from forming an effective team of peers for connection and accountability. We’ve also had many friends and loved ones who have dealt with these challenges, and so it’s a problem we’re deeply passionate about solving.

launches.body:
Hey all, I’m Josh, Co-Founder of Overlord, with my friend Eddie. We’re aiming to build the Holy Grail of productivity apps - an AI agent to replace self-control.

Here’s our landing page: [www.overlord.app](http://www.overlord.app)

Here’s the link if you want to chat with it: [chat.overlord.app](http://chat.overlord.app)

Imagine you hired someone to stay awake 24/7, sat behind a big computer screen, monitoring you - knowing where you are (GPS), what website you’re on (Mac integration), what you spend money on. They can take actions: texting/calling you, charging you money, blocking your iOS/Android apps, blocking websites on your Mac, texting friends if you’ve fallen off the wagon.

Overlord has been in a closed beta for about a year, and has had hundreds of thousands of messages sent to it by users. It’s specifically meant to be weasel-proof, so we’ve put a lot of effort into making sure there are no easy workarounds. Our target users are the type of people that have their friends manage their Screen Time passcodes, and have web blockers all over their Mac.

Here are a few examples of what Overlord can do:

* **Staying sober:** “Send a video blowing 0.00 on a breathalyser each night at 11pm, or text Jane: “John has skipped his evening check-in. Ensure he’s not relapsed”.”
* **Undistracted on Mac:** “Lock me in from 9-5 each day on my Mac. Annoy me if I go on anything unrelated to work, and block if I go on any rabbit holes. Work is anything coding related.”
* **Not skipping cardio:** “When I enter the gym, make sure I send a photo of 10 mins cardio, or charge me $5".”
* **My personal screen block:** “Block Instagram at all times, allowing me 1 min an hour, 15 mins if I send a photo of a meal, and unblock on Friday/Saturday nights from 7pm-4am. Charge me $50 if I disable Screen Time Permissions.”
* **Mac productivity to co-founder:** “Track my Mac. Send a text to my co-founder of my total productive time each day at 11pm.”
* **Showering after gym:** “When i get home from the gym, make sure I send a selfie if my hair wet within 30 mins or lose $5”

**_No processed food:_** “Each time I spend money at Trader Joe’s or Whole Foods, make sure I send a receipt (with the exact amount spent to ensure I’m not cheating) and it must not have anything processed on it. Also no purchases from any dollar pizza store. If I do, charge me $50.”

https://youtu.be/Cr1A0j6LBec

**_Morning routine w/ screen blocking + charging:_**\_ “Call me to wake me up at 7am, and block my apps at this point. I must send a photo of my fridge at 7:05, a video brushing teeth by 7:10, a photo of a coffee by 7:20, and a photo outside by 7:30 (unblock my phone at this point). If I miss any of these, call me, then if I am not telling you I’m taking action on the phone, charge me $1.”

https://youtu.be/TVSTbu3jwKA

**_Getting to work immediately:_**\_ “Once I arrive at the office, I must start a 2hr focus session on my Mac within 15 minutes. If I exit this, or spend more than 10 mins distracted or inactive total, charge me $5 and text my co-founder that I’m distracted. Block all distracting sites.”

https://youtu.be/I0NvyW7RQYM

**Asks:**

1. Give it a go at [chat.overlord.app](http://chat.overlord.app) ! See if any goals you can set up with it would be useful to you. No login required.
2. Comment down below if there are any goals/capabilities you’d like to see - there’s a bit of a learning curve to Overlord, but it can be extremely powerful once you get the hang of it.

launches.body:
### **Tl;dr:** _[_Orchid_](https://orchid.health) is an Electronic Health Record (EHR) for independent mental health professionals that saves clinicians’ time, money, and frustration. We do this by integrating core administrative workflows, streamlining clinical processes, and automating manual flows. Altogether, Orchid practitioners reclaim \~500+ hours of their time spent on administrative work, with the potential to save $11B in healthcare costs annually._

### _Would you or anyone in your network be interested in learning more or helping out? [**Connect with us**](mailto:founders@orchid.health)_

 

### **The Problem** 

Did you know that **mental health professionals** spend more time on their EHR than they do with their patients? In fact, they **lose 500 hours a year** by clicking around terrible infrastructure and as a result the **healthcare industry loses $11 billion annually**.

Mental health clinicians face the following set of challenges:

1. Subpar EHR solutions cost mental health clinicians \~1,500 hours/year
2. This admin time detracts from time spent with patients, translating into $10,000+ of lost revenue per clinician
3. Lost revenue and less time with patients leads to stress and ultimately to clinician burnout 

No wonder it’s so hard to find a therapist these days, and it all starts with clunky software! 

At Orchid we believe the path to helping those seeking mental health care runs through helping mental health clinicians. We need to figure out an affordable way to buy back the time of these mental health professionals because every hour wasted is an hour not spent addressing the mountain of unmet demand in this market and results in billions wasted for our healthcare industry. 

### **The Solution**

Enter Orchid. **We are an affordable EHR that seamlessly integrates the core functions of running a mental healthcare practice.** 

Imagine an all-in-one platform that automates scheduling, billing, insurance credentialing, analytics, telehealth, and note-taking. By doing this **we reclaim 500 hours of each provider annually, and we potentially save the healthcare industry 11 billion dollars**. 

Orchid not only helps clinicians improve the mental health outcomes of their patients but also alleviates the supply-demand imbalance in the mental healthcare market by enabling clinicians to spend more time both onboarding new patients and focusing on their current patient roster.

**Read what Orchid subscribers are saying about how Orchid reduces their admin work**:

### **Make the world a better place**

**If you or anyone in your network might be interested in learning more or helping out, we would love to chat.**  We're especially interested in talking with:

* **Health insurance companies (payors)**, especially those interested in expanding their mental health offerings, in increasing their members’ access to mental healthcare, in decreasing their costs through efficient operations, and in improving their quality of care. **We have hundreds of vetted clinicians implementing measurement-based care.**
* **Independent mental health professionals**: therapists, social workers, psychologists, and psychiatrists, even if they’re currently not in the market for a new EHR. You can also ask them to [sign up for a quick 15-minute demo](https://orchid.health). 
* **Nonprofits** with an interest in supporting mental health
